# Support

| You need | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Help using the framework, an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/ai-driven-dev/framework/discussions) |
| Real-time chat | [Discord](https://discord.gg/EWySJSpjWs) |
| A bug | [Bug report](https://github.com/ai-driven-dev/framework/issues/new/choose) |
| Not sure it is a bug | [Discussions](https://github.com/ai-driven-dev/framework/discussions). Support questions opened as issues are moved there |
| A feature | A feature request, or an idea in Discussions. See [how the roadmap is set](../GOVERNANCE.md#influence-the-roadmap). |
| A security vulnerability | [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md). Never a public issue. |
| Guides and training | [ai-driven-dev.fr](https://www.ai-driven-dev.fr/) |
